https.title: Served over HTTPS
https.fix: Install a TLS certificate (free with Let’s Encrypt or your host) and redirect HTTP to HTTPS.

hsts.title: HSTS header
hsts.fix: Add Strict-Transport-Security so browsers always use HTTPS.

securityHeaders.title: Security headers
securityHeaders.fix: Add Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options and Referrer-Policy.

responseTime.title: Server response time
responseTime.fix: Aim for under 800 ms: cache pages, use a CDN and avoid slow server-side calls.

pageWeight.title: HTML size
pageWeight.fix: Keep the HTML under 150 KB: remove inline data, unused markup and big inline scripts.

compression.title: Compression
compression.fix: Enable Brotli or gzip on your server or CDN.

caching.title: Caching headers
caching.fix: Send Cache-Control, ETag or Last-Modified so repeat visits are faster.

renderBlocking.title: Render-blocking scripts
renderBlocking.fix: Add async or defer to scripts in the head, or move them to the end of the body.

title.title: Page title
title.fix: Write a unique title of 10–70 characters with your main keyword.

metaDescription.title: Meta description
metaDescription.fix: Add a 50–170 character description that makes people want to click.

h1.title: One H1 heading
h1.fix: Use exactly one H1 that says what the page is about.

canonical.title: Canonical URL
canonical.fix: Add a rel=canonical link tag in the head to avoid duplicate-content issues.

openGraph.title: Open Graph tags
openGraph.fix: Add og:title, og:description and og:image so links look good when shared.

indexable.title: Indexable by search engines
indexable.fix: Remove “noindex” from the robots meta tag or X-Robots-Tag header.

robotsTxt.title: robots.txt
robotsTxt.fix: Publish a robots.txt at the root of your domain.

sitemap.title: XML sitemap
sitemap.fix: Publish sitemap.xml and reference it from robots.txt.

viewport.title: Mobile viewport
viewport.fix: Add a viewport meta tag with width=device-width, initial-scale=1.

icons.title: Favicon / app icon
icons.fix: Add a favicon and an apple-touch-icon.

lang.title: Page language
lang.fix: Set the lang attribute on the html element, e.g. lang=en.

imageAlt.title: Image alt text
imageAlt.fix: Describe every meaningful image with alt text (use an empty alt for decorative ones).

linkText.title: Links with text
linkText.fix: Give icon-only links an aria-label so screen readers can announce them.

formLabels.title: Form labels
formLabels.fix: Connect every input to a label element or give it an aria-label.

email-signature-generator.name: Email signature generator
email-signature-generator.short: Professional signatures that work in Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail.
email-signature-generator.metaTitle: Free email signature generator (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail)
email-signature-generator.metaDescription: Create a professional HTML email signature in a minute. Four templates, your colors, social links and a “Book a meeting” button. Free, no sign-up, no tracking pixels.
email-signature-generator.title: Email signature generator
email-signature-generator.sub: Fill in your details, pick a template and copy it straight into Gmail, Outlook or Apple Mail. Table-based HTML that renders everywhere — and no tracking pixels.
email-signature-generator.ctaBody: Add a free zerosoft Cal booking page to your signature and let people pick a time without the back-and-forth.

faq.q: Will the signature look the same in Gmail and Outlook?
faq.a: Yes. The templates use tables and inline styles, the only formatting all major email clients agree on. Fonts fall back to Arial if needed.

faq.q: Why doesn’t my photo show up?
faq.a: The photo must be a public image URL (for example from your website or LinkedIn). Some clients block remote images until the recipient allows them.

faq.q: Do you track who opens my emails?
faq.a: No. The signature has no tracking pixels and nothing is sent to our servers — it is generated in your browser.

faq.q: Is it really free?
faq.a: Yes, free with no sign-up. Your details are saved only in your browser so you can come back and edit them.

qr-code-generator.name: QR code generator
qr-code-generator.short: QR codes for links, Wi-Fi, contacts and email. PNG or SVG.
qr-code-generator.metaTitle: Free QR code generator — URL, Wi-Fi, vCard, PNG & SVG
qr-code-generator.metaDescription: Make QR codes for links, Wi-Fi networks, contact cards and emails. Custom colors, size and error correction. Download PNG or SVG. Free, no sign-up, never expires.
qr-code-generator.title: QR code generator
qr-code-generator.sub: Create a QR code for a link, a Wi-Fi network, a contact card or an email. Choose colors and size, then download it as PNG or SVG. Generated in your browser.
qr-code-generator.ctaBody: With zerosoft Link your QR codes point to a short link you can edit anytime, with scan analytics by country, device and date.

faq.q: Do these QR codes expire?
faq.a: No. They are static codes: the content is encoded in the image itself, so they work forever and don’t depend on our servers.

faq.q: PNG or SVG?
faq.a: SVG scales to any size without losing quality — best for print. PNG is easiest for web, slides and documents.

faq.q: Can I see how many people scanned it?
faq.a: Not with a static code. Point the QR at a zerosoft Link short link to count scans and change the destination later.

faq.q: What error correction should I use?
faq.a: Medium works for most uses. Choose High if the code will be printed small, on rough surfaces, or with a logo on top.

invoice-generator.short: Professional invoices with taxes and discounts. Download as PDF.
invoice-generator.metaTitle: Free invoice generator — download PDF, no sign-up
invoice-generator.metaDescription: Create a professional invoice with your logo, line items, taxes, discounts and any currency. Download it as PDF. Free, no sign-up, drafts saved in your browser.
invoice-generator.title: Invoice generator
invoice-generator.sub: Add your details, line items, taxes and discount — totals update as you type. Download a clean PDF in any currency. Your draft stays in your browser.
invoice-generator.ctaTitle: Keep every client and deal in one place
invoice-generator.ctaBody: zerosoft CRM tracks contacts, companies and deals for free, so you always know who to bill next.

faq.q: How do I download the invoice as PDF?
faq.a: Click “Download PDF” and choose “Save as PDF” in your browser’s print dialog. Only the invoice is printed, without the form.

faq.q: How are taxes and discounts calculated?
faq.a: The discount is applied to the subtotal first and spread across the lines; tax is then calculated per line on the discounted amount, rounded to the currency’s cents.

faq.q: Is my data stored anywhere?
faq.a: Only in your browser’s local storage, so you can close the tab and continue later. Nothing is sent to our servers.

faq.q: Is this invoice valid for tax purposes?
faq.a: It depends on your country. Some countries require electronic invoicing or specific fields. Check with your accountant.

faq.a: Public list prices for each vendor’s entry paid tier, billed annually, in USD. Vendors change plans often — check their pricing pages for your exact case.

faq.q: Is zerosoft really free?

faq.q: Does zerosoft replace every tool on the list?
faq.a: Link, CRM, Cal, Track, Chat and Docs are available today. Flow, Board and Notes are on the way.

faq.q: Does it cover GDPR and CCPA?

faq.q: Which language is the policy generated in?
faq.a: In the language of this page. Switch the site language to generate it in English, Spanish or Portuguese.

faq.q: Do you store what I type?

website-grader.ctaBody: Share tracked short links with zerosoft Link and see clicks by source, country and device — free.

faq.q: What does the grader check?
faq.a: HTTPS and security headers, server response time, HTML size, compression and caching, title, meta description, headings, canonical, Open Graph, robots.txt, sitemap, viewport, icons, language, alt text, link text and form labels.

faq.q: Is it the same as Google PageSpeed?
faq.a: No. We check the HTML and headers your server returns, which is fast and catches most basics. PageSpeed runs a full browser for detailed performance metrics.

faq.q: Can it check pages behind a login?
faq.a: No, only public pages reachable over the internet.

faq.q: Is there a limit?

utm-builder.name: UTM builder
utm-builder.short: Tracked campaign URLs for analytics, in one click.
utm-builder.metaTitle: Free UTM builder — campaign URL generator
utm-builder.metaDescription: Build campaign URLs with UTM parameters (source, medium, campaign, term, content) for Google Analytics and any analytics tool. Presets and clean, consistent values. Free.
utm-builder.title: UTM builder
utm-builder.sub: Add utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign to any link so your analytics know where every visit came from. Consistent, lowercase values by default.
utm-builder.ctaTitle: Shorten it and count the clicks
utm-builder.ctaBody: Paste your UTM link into zerosoft Link to get a short, branded URL, a QR code and click analytics — free.

faq.q: Which UTM parameters are required?
faq.a: Use source, medium and campaign on every link. Term and content are optional.

faq.q: Why lowercase?
faq.a: Analytics tools treat “Email” and “email” as different values. Keeping everything lowercase avoids split reports.

faq.q: Can I use UTMs on internal links?
faq.a: Avoid it: they reset the session source in analytics. Use them only for links from outside your site.
